The unique maximizing orbit under the actual48 gate automorphisms complements exactly one block, and its minimum E lies strictly between334828508/100000000 and334828510/100000000, hence above669/200. For any core of minority probability0<p<=1/16, complementing exactly one of six identical minority-oriented blocks yields minority sigma(p)=4p-10p^2+18p^3-19p^4+10p^5-2p^6, with3p<sigma(p)<4p<=1/4. This gives finite-step bias escape but no monotone-erasure or terminal-entropy payment theorem and no FEI resolution.
